# Context menus on darwin; enablement per state: disconnected, connected, running, busy
editor.context, for the query editor
  &Insert Snippet…  ⌘K ⌘X  +++-
  &Surround With…  ⌘K ⌘S  +++-
  ---
  C&onnection >
    &Connect…  ++++
    &Disconnect  -+--
    Disconnect &All Queries  -++-
    &Reconnect…  ++++
    ---
    C&hange Connection…  ++--
    &Environment…  -++-
  ---
  E&xecute  F5  ++--
  Ca&ncel Executing Query  --+-
  ---
  Cu&t  ⌘X  ++++
  &Copy  ⌘C  ++++
  &Paste  ⌘V  ++++
  ---
  Comm&and Palette…  ⇧⌘P  ++++
documentTab.context, for a saved query's tab
  &Save  ⌘S  +++-
  Save &As…  ⇧⌘S  +++-
  ---
  &Close  ⌘W  +++-
  Close All &But This  +++-
  C&lose All  +++-
  ---
  Copy Full &Path  ++++
  Reveal in Finder  ++++

explorer.context, for a database
  New &Query  -++-
  ---
  &Script Database as >
    &CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &ALTER To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &DROP To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    DROP A&nd CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
  ---
  Copy N&ame  -+++
  ---
  Rena&me  F2  -+++
  D&elete  ⌘⌫  -+++
  ---
  Re&fresh  F5  -+++
  ---
  &Properties  ⌘I  -+++

explorer.context, for a table
  Select Top 1000 Ro&ws  -++-
  ---
  &Script Table as >
    &CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &ALTER To >
      &New Query Editor Window  ----
      &File…  ----
      C&lipboard  ----
    C&REATE OR ALTER To >
      &New Query Editor Window  ----
      &File…  ----
      C&lipboard  ----
    &DROP To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    DROP A&nd CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    ---
    &SELECT To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &INSERT To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &UPDATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    D&ELETE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    ---
    E&XECUTE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  ----
      &File…  ----
      C&lipboard  ----
  ---
  Copy N&ame  -+++
  ---
  Rena&me  F2  -+++
  D&elete  ⌘⌫  -+++
  ---
  Re&fresh  F5  -+++
